description.value:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This bowl of tasty porridge fills you with warmth as you eat it, soothing sore joints or small scrapes. You immediately feel as though you've eaten your fill, regain @Damage[1d10[healing]] Hit Points, and gain a +1 status bonus to Reflex saving throws for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Filling Porridge]

In addition to gaining the benefits of the porridge upon eating it, you must attempt a @Check[will|dc:16|showDC:all] save. On a failure, you take a –1 item penalty to saves against spells and effects from fey creatures for 24 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Fey Feast Penalty]
